data.description:
## Context / Problem
The new ownership-direction gate (slice C1) and the existing field-consumption gate `scripts/check_config_reads.py` are only useful if they run on every change through the portable local gate AND CI, and if the workflow cannot silently drop either invocation. rebar must work with diverse CI providers or NO CI provider, so the primary trigger must be the portable local `make lint` path, with CI as a mirror.

## Outcome
`make lint` runs BOTH the ownership-direction and field-consumption gates as part of the portable, no-CI-required local gate; the build workflow runs both; and the CI workflow-parity tests fail if either gate invocation disappears from the Makefile or the workflow.

## Plan
1. Add both gate invocations to the `lint` target in `Makefile` (the portable/no-CI path).
2. Add both to `.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml`.
3. Extend `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` so the workflow cannot silently omit either invocation.

## Testing (RED -> GREEN)
- A parity test asserts that removing the ownership-gate invocation from the Makefile OR from the workflow fails the parity check (fed synthetic edited copies), and likewise for the field-consumption gate.
- `make lint` executes both gates and remains green on the current tree (with C1's populated legacy-exception set).
- The gates run under `make lint` with NO CI provider present (portable path), proving the trigger is operation-linked, not CI-only.

## Compatibility / rollback
Wiring-only; no product-code change. Rollback removes the added invocations and reverts the parity-test extension.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `make lint` executes both the ownership-direction gate and the field-consumption gate; the CI build workflow executes both.
- [ ] The workflow-parity tests fail if either gate invocation is removed from the Makefile or from the workflow.
- [ ] `make lint` runs both gates with no CI provider present (portable/no-CI path) and remains green on the current tree.
data.title: RP-04 S7.2 — Wire ownership + field-consumption gates into make lint + CI parity
